sections.text:
Ability Power 200. Damages all enemies 4 times with magic wind damage at success of 80 points.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.

-Increases the physical attack Ability Power limit of all allies by 20 for 60 seconds. Increases the magic attack Ability Power limit of all allies by 20 for 60 seconds.
-Recovers 20 Cost for all allies.
-Casts frenzy your character for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5000

Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5000
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases physical and magic Ability Power of all allies by 20 for 60 seconds.
